title: A Multimodal Foundation Agent for Financial Trading: Tool-Augmented, Diversified, and Generalist

claim.summary: FinAgent combines multimodal market intelligence, vector memory, price-level reflection and trading-outcome reflection to select financial actions.

modules.name: Vector-indexed summaries and query retrieval
modules.scope_reason: Summaries and query fields stored and retrieved by vector similarity form a generic memory mechanism.

modules.name: Market and trade-outcome reflection
modules.scope_reason: Low/high reflection explicitly interprets market-price movements and prior trading actions.
